code: library(CorOncoEndpoints)  ctl <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6, orr = 0.30, resp.cor = 0.40,                death.prop = 0.15, os.median = 15, pps.hr.resp = 0.6) trt <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6 / 0.7, orr = 0.45, resp.cor = 0.40,                death.prop = 0.15, pps.hazard = ctl$gam0, pps.hr.resp = 0.6) ctl                  # calibrated parameters, implied medians and correlations CorEndpoints(trt)    # Corr(PFS, R), Corr(OS, R), Corr(PFS, OS), partial correlation  arms <- list(Control = ctl, Treatment = trt) dat <- rOncoEndpoints(nsim = 1000, n = c(350, 350), arms = arms,                       a.time = c(0, 24), seed = 1)  # number of OS events for 80% power of the one-sided log-rank test at 2.5% RequiredEvents(arms, n = c(350, 350), a.time = c(0, 24), endpoint = "os")  # data at the calendar time of the 366th OS event in each simulated trial cut <- CutoffData(dat, EventTime(dat, events = 366, endpoint = "os"))

what: CorOncoEndpoints: Correlated Progression-Free Survival, Overall Survival and Objective Response — CorOncoEndpoints-package
title: CorOncoEndpoints: Correlated Progression-Free Survival, Overall Survival and Objective Response — CorOncoEndpoints-package
text: package generates progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS) binary objective response oncology trial simulations three endpoints patient dependent clinically interpretable way. treatment group described object created OncoArm. PFS follows exponential distribution exactly response probability equals specified objective response rate exactly. PFS response linked Gaussian copula. OS obtained illness-death structure: PFS event death specified probability otherwise progression, patient survives post-progression time. Two models OS available. os.model = "idm" Time-constant pre-progression hazards     exponential post-progression survival whose hazard may differ     pre-progression death hazard may depend response. OS     mixture exponential distributions closed-form one-dimensional     integral survival function. os.model = "expexp" PFS OS exactly exponential.     pre-progression death hazard decreases time     post-progression hazard determined exponential OS distribution,     specified separately depend response. Main functions: OncoArm Define one treatment group design inputs     (medians, response rate, association) calibrate generator. rOncoEndpoints Generate patient-level data one     groups many simulated trials, accrual dropout. CorEndpoints Pearson correlations among PFS, OS     response implied group. SurvEndpoint, QuantileEndpoint Survival,     density, hazard quantiles PFS OS, overall response. CorBoundPFSResponse Attainable range PFS     response correlation. ExpectedEvents, AverageHR,     RequiredEvents Expected events, average hazard ratio     number events required log-rank test. CutoffData, EventTime Data analysis     cutoff event-driven cutoff times.

text: package rewritten. treatment group now defined OncoArm(), rOncoEndpoints() takes list OncoArm objects (arms), sample sizes, accrual, dropout seed. Response now linked PFS (Gaussian copula) instead death time. version 0.1.0, response linked OS Clayton Frank copula time progression independent response, Corr(PFS, R) always smaller Corr(OS, R). Removed CheckSimResults(), CopulaParamResponseTTE(), CorBoundResponsePFS(), CorBoundResponseTTE() CorResponsePFS().

title: CorOncoEndpoints 0.2.0
text: OncoArm() calibrates generator design inputs: PFS median hazard, objective response rate, correlation PFS response (resp.cor) median PFS responders (resp.pfs.median), proportion PFS events deaths (death.prop), OS median post-progression survival. Two OS models: os.model = "idm" (illness-death model death hazard progression can differ death hazard progression can depend response pps.hr.resp) os.model = "expexp" (PFS OS exactly exponential). Timing response: resp.timing = "landmark" (responders PFS longer resp.tau) resp.timing = "ttr" (time response resp.tau PFS). PFS stays exactly exponential response probability stays exactly orr. CorEndpoints(), SurvEndpoint(), QuantileEndpoint() CorBoundPFSResponse() give implied correlations, survival functions, quantiles attainable range PFS response correlation. ExpectedEvents(), AverageHR() RequiredEvents() compute expected events, average hazard ratio number events required log-rank test OS hazards proportional. CutoffData() EventTime() give data analysis cutoff, including response observed cutoff, event-driven cutoff times. Random numbers generated ‘dqrng’ transformed C++ via ‘Rcpp’.

text: rOncoEndpoints(): Generate correlated OS, PFS, Response endpoints Support 7 different endpoint patterns (OS , PFS , Response , OS+Response, PFS+Response, OS+PFS, OS+PFS+Response) Multi-group support comparing multiple treatment arms Automatic enforcement PFS ≤ OS constraint Clayton copula (lower tail dependence, positive correlations ) Frank copula (flexible symmetric dependence, positive negative correlations) CheckSimResults(): Validate simulation results theoretical values Calculate bias, relative bias, SE, MSE, RMSE Compare empirical estimates theoretical expectations CorResponsePFS(): Calculate PFS-Response correlation OS-PFS-Response framework CorBoundResponsePFS(): Compute correlation bounds PFS-Response CorBoundResponseTTE(): Compute general correlation bounds TTE-Response CopulaParamResponseTTE(): Calculate copula parameters given correlations
